title: critoniopsis standleyi
intro: Critoniopsis standleyi, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family, is native to Mexico. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Critoniopsis standleyi include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful in treating various health conditions.
